requested_primary_changes.reason: The three Vector, Graph and Hybrid retriever functions use bare LangSmith @traceable decorators. The installed decorator defaults process_inputs and process_outputs to None, so enabled tracing serializes the query/context inputs and full result dictionaries, including chunk_text, citations and untrusted error strings, instead of a compact allowlisted summary.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Add deterministic process_inputs/process_outputs redaction for all three retriever traces. Inputs may expose only bounded ForecastContext/version identity and non-sensitive operation labels; outputs may expose only result/evidence/citation counts, branch availability, deterministic degradation codes and safe identity/version metadata. Do not trace query text, chunk/article text, full result/citation payloads, URLs/titles, prompts, credentials, headers, raw backend payloads or exception text. Include stage=04A, stage_revision=1, attempt=1 and agent=data_rag at the current attempt boundary, and add offline sentinel tests proving raw query/evidence/URL/secret/exception text is absent from processed trace inputs and outputs.

requested_primary_changes.reason: LangSmith provides automatic duration for the three decorated retriever spans, but there is no safe Vector/Graph/RRF lifecycle summary, no RRF-specific span or measured latency, no compact result/evidence/citation counts, and no Graph extraction/upsert latency/count/degraded lifecycle telemetry. Stage 04A therefore cannot correlate its explicit degradation modes with branch and fusion latency or counts without retaining full outputs.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Instrument Vector, Graph, RRF fusion and overall Hybrid boundaries with monotonic measured latency or an equivalently scoped redacted span. Emit compact allowlisted ForecastContext metadata where available (ticker, as_of, target, horizon, analysis_mode, dataset/feature/model/schema/calendar versions), Stage identity, result/evidence/citation counts, branch availability and deterministic degraded flags. Add compact extraction/upsert completion/failure telemetry with document/entity/relation/skipped counts. Treat retrieval as stateless with resume=not_applicable; describe Graph write recovery as caller retry over deterministic MERGE identities, and expose partial-batch failure as a sanitized failed/degraded lifecycle outcome rather than fabricating checkpoint resume. Add offline assertions for non-negative latency, counts, hybrid/vector_only/graph_only/unavailable modes, failure and retry-safe outcomes.

requested_primary_changes.reason: Current failure paths return str(exc) from both retrieval branches, log original backend exception text, log a source URL during Graph extraction failure, and send the original extraction exception to Sentry. When tracing or log/event persistence is enabled, provider messages or captured locals can contain secrets, private URLs, raw request/evidence text or payload fragments.
requested_primary_changes.requested_change: Replace persisted/reflected exception strings with deterministic codes such as VECTOR_RETRIEVAL_FAILED, GRAPH_TRAVERSAL_FAILED, GRAPH_EXTRACTION_FAILED and GRAPH_UPSERT_FAILED. Keep original exceptions out of result dictionaries, breadcrumbs, logs and trace outputs; report sanitized exceptions to Sentry without raw prompt/text/source URL/provider payload locals. Add sentinel tests using secret, raw-evidence and private-URL exception messages and assert none appear in results, processed traces, breadcrumbs, logs or captured exception values.

privacy_checks.check: Temporal context and citations preserve bounded identities without chain-of-thought.
privacy_checks.evidence: ForecastContext is shared across Vector and Graph; citations retain document_id, chunk_id, evidence_id and Graph observation_id. No chain-of-thought or brain_reasoning field was added by the Stage 04A draft.

privacy_checks.check: Explicit API degradation is deterministic and does not fall back from temporal Graph to legacy traversal.
privacy_checks.evidence: The focused temporal fixture tests passed for hybrid, vector_only, graph_only and unavailable modes, including the graph_error no-legacy-fallback counterexample.

privacy_checks.check: Enabled LangSmith tracing serializes only compact allowlisted metadata.
privacy_checks.evidence: rag/hybrid_rag.py has three bare @traceable retriever decorators and zero process_inputs/process_outputs processors. Default LangSmith behavior records function inputs and outputs, which include query and full result chunk/citation payloads. OBS-04A-001 is blocking.
Static audit found two raw str(exc) response fields, two Hybrid exception log sites, three Graph exception log sites and one capture_exception(exc) call. OBS-04A-003 is blocking.

privacy_checks.check: No external trace provider, database, migration, seed, deployment, commit or push was contacted by this audit.

lifecycle_audit.vector: Explicit unavailable/error degradation and context-bound retrieval exist; compact safe lifecycle latency/count metadata is missing.
lifecycle_audit.graph: Explicit unavailable/error degradation and fail-closed temporal traversal exist; compact safe lifecycle latency/count metadata is missing.
lifecycle_audit.rrf: Deterministic fusion and citation retention exist; RRF has no separately scoped latency/count instrumentation.
lifecycle_audit.graph_write: Temporal MERGE identities make caller retry idempotent in principle, but no checkpoint resume contract exists and partial-batch failure has no sanitized lifecycle summary.

tests_run.command: read-only static counts for trace processors, latency fields, raw exception responses/logs and original Sentry exception capture
tests_run.result: 3 decorators; 0 input processors; 0 output processors; 0 explicit latency fields; 2 raw exception responses; 2 Hybrid exception logs; 3 Graph exception logs; 1 original exception capture

blocking_issues: OBS-04A-001: Bare LangSmith traces can persist query and full raw result/evidence/citation/error payloads instead of redacted summaries.
OBS-04A-002: Vector/Graph/RRF/Hybrid and Graph write lifecycle latency/count/degradation instrumentation is incomplete.
OBS-04A-003: Original exception strings, source URL context and exception objects can reach response, logs, trace output or Sentry persistence.
limitations: No production latency benchmark or external tracing run was performed; automatic span duration behavior was inspected from the installed local LangSmith implementation.
Temporal Graph behavior remains fixture/mock validated; no Neo4j migration, reconciliation or external count was authorized or attempted.
Observability did not edit feature, test, state, migration or shared instrumentation files.
